aggregate_scope: Fresh AI-authored server-closure confirmation on 96 documents from 12 semantic families, balanced between short and long sources. This is not human workplace gold or a deployment risk estimate.
cost_interpretation: Request wall time includes local parsing and execution validation; preparation costs are measured separately. Snapshot compilation counts only actual compilations, excluding cached zero-cost entries. Shared-host measurements are descriptive, not service-load SLOs.
inference_unit: case; shared documents, semantic families and conditions are not independent samples
limitations: All decisions are evaluation-only shadow observations with execution_authority=none; no action is executed.
The supported-shadow source ownership, positive-support, explicit-conflict and occurrence checks are unchanged across all five arms.
Server closure adds only the exact requested target sentence and parents of model-selected attribute anchors; it never supplies an entity, assessment or attribute claim.
Unknown, stale, duplicate or other-occurrence references are not repaired, and original selected evidence is never removed to conceal contradictions.
A discriminated null wire accepts only request reference and e=null; link branches require SUPPORT and still undergo the complete unchanged gate.
Source-only bundles enumerate individual compatible owned attributes and a bounded combined set, not semantic entailment or authorization.
Every arm receives the same full document, complete definitions, ownership inventory and bundle catalog; policies and response transport are the manipulated factors.
Missing applicability values remain UNKNOWN; the server does not infer missing facts or create new support.
Sources and annotations are AI authored and independently AI reviewed, not human gold or actual workplace records.
Document and family provenance is retained; model calls and paired conditions are not independent documents.
metric_interpretation: Raw semantic selection and occurrence-bound approval are separate; synthetic/public proxy samples do not certify deployment risk.
proposal_interpretation: All arms report experimental shadow judgments without execution authority. Model semantic proposals, pre-closure evidence validation, server-closed validation and the unchanged production occurrence-guard result are separate. Server closure only adds source-bound segments for the selected occurrence and attributes; it does not prove semantic entailment.
unknown_attribute_interpretation: Unknown-attribute counts describe absent selected supporting claims. Null proposals leave every attribute UNKNOWN; these counts do not establish that the source lacks the attribute, or that an unstated attribute is false.
